name: Website Content Update
description: Update text content on the tachin.ai marketing website — copy edits, new announcements, team bios, wording fixes. Does NOT change layout, styling, or functionality. Use for any change that is purely about words on a page.

target_pages.description: Which page(s) to change, e.g. index.html, about.html

steps.title: Gather context and draft the content
steps.description:
Prepare the content change: ${request}

1. Read the current content of the target page(s) (${target_pages}) from operator/sites/tachin-website/ in the repo.
2. Read operator/docs/TACHIN_SITE_IA.md to confirm the page's purpose and voice.
3. Draft the new copy. Match the established voice: clear, warm, credible, healthcare-appropriate. No hype, no jargon.
4. Produce the exact before/after text for each change.
steps.accept_criteria: Before/after text drafted for every change. Voice matches the IA guide. No layout or style changes proposed.

steps.title: Apply the content change
steps.description:
Apply the drafted copy to the page file(s).

1. Edit ONLY text nodes — do not touch HTML structure, classes, or CSS.
2. Preserve all existing markup and design-system classes exactly.
3. Save the complete modified file(s).
steps.accept_criteria: Text updated in the file(s). No markup/class/style changes. Branch created.

steps.title: Self-check the content change
steps.description:
⚠️ READ-ONLY STEP — do NOT modify anything.

Verify the change:
1. Re-read the modified file(s) — confirm the requested text was updated correctly.
2. Check the copy for typos, tone, and accuracy.
3. Confirm no HTML structure, classes, or CSS were altered — only text content should differ.
steps.accept_criteria: File re-read confirms the requested text was updated. No typos. Voice consistent. No HTML/CSS changes.

steps.title: Owner review
steps.description: Present the before/after copy and the diff to the owner for review.
steps.approval_message: 📝 Content update ready for ${target_pages}. Review the before/after copy and reply approve or reject.
